summary: Backend + Frontend E2E for Phase D (Plan-ahead Shifts) and Phase E (Bank Reconcile). Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/backend_iteration22_test.py after fixing ONE critical crash in POST /api/bank/import (KeyError: 'id' — matched invoice doc from Mongo has _id, not id). Frontend on mobile viewport 390x844, logged in as TEST_USER_EMAIL: (D1) end-shift-btn ends any active shift → planning view renders correctly; (D2) two shiftclient-<id> rows selectable; before setting a date the primary CTA is start-shift-btn 'Start now (2)'; after typing 31/12/2026 in schedule-date it flips to plan-shift-btn 'Plan shift (2)'. (D3) Tapping plan-shift-btn creates a planned-<id> card under 'Planned shifts' with 'Activate' + close-icon; card shows '31/12/2026' calendar chip and '2 participants · $0.00'. (D4) activate-<id> flips app to active shift view with live 'On shift since …' banner and 2 draft-<invId> rows listed. (D5) cancel-plan-<id> triggers a native/web confirm, removes the planned card and its draft invoices. (D6) With clients selected and date cleared, start-shift-btn 'Start now (1)' immediately starts a live shift. (E1) Reports → open-bank-reconcile → bank-screen loads with Paste statement CSV, Pick .csv file (bank-pick-file), Import & match (bank-import-btn). (E2) Pasting 'Date,Description,Amount\n01/07/2026,Payment INV-1008,258.39\n02/07/2026,Woolworths,-45.30' and tapping bank-import-btn imported 2 rows (txn-<oid>). Credit row auto-matched: shows 'Matches INV-1008 · Mark paid' with testID reconcile-<txnId>. (E3) bank-select-all toggles all txn-select-<id>; unselecting hides the reconcile-selected-btn footer; re-selecting shows 'Reconcile selected (1)' — only CREDIT with a match counts. Tapping reconcile-selected-btn marks the invoice PAID (verified via GET /api/invoices/{id} status==paid). (E4) ignore-<id> removes row locally + server-side (status=ignored). bank-clear-btn (top-right trash) clears all txns via DELETE /api/bank/transactions. (E5) Reports BAS/GST-collected updated LIVE: 2,274.32 → 2,532.71 (delta $258.39 matches INV-1008 total). Zero i18n key leaks (bank.*, shift.*) — all 82 shift keys + 33 bank keys resolved in en.json. Deprecated packages check: no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch found. Only pre-existing RN-Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, Image.style.resizeMode) carried over from iters 18-21 — cosmetic.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec says debit rows with no match should display 'No matching invoice'. Current code only renders bank.noMatch when `credit && !suggested_invoice_id`; for debit rows without a match it renders `null` (no helper text — only 'Ignore' visible). Minor UX polish: consider rendering the noMatch label for debits too, or a friendlier 'Debit — not reconcilable' label. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/bank.tsx:172-174.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props, props.pointerEvents, and Image.style.resizeMode are still logged on every navigation. Carried over from iterations 18-21; not introduced this round. Migrate to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents / props.resizeMode when convenient.

action_items: FIXED IN THIS ITERATION: POST /api/bank/import was crashing with 500 KeyError: 'id'. The Mongo document returned from _suggest_match() has `_id` (ObjectId) not the doc_out()-serialised `id`. Fix applied at /app/backend/server.py:1905 → use `str(match['_id'])` when populating suggested_invoice_id. Backend restarted and all 16 pytest cases pass.

OPTIONAL polish: Show 'No matching invoice' (bank.noMatch) for DEBIT rows without a match too, not just credits. Currently debits render only the 'Ignore' link with no explanatory text. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/bank.tsx:167-174.
OPTIONAL (carry-over from iters 18-21): migrate shadow* → boxShadow, props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents, Image.style.resizeMode → props.resizeMode. Cosmetic RN-Web deprecations.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py bank_import() previously assumed the invoice dict from _suggest_match had an `id` key. That helper returns the raw Mongo doc (contains _id: ObjectId), never routed through doc_out(). Fixed by using str(match['_id']). Consider running match through doc_out() inside _suggest_match to keep the contract consistent.

server.py _suggest_match uses a scoring loop that always prefers score==2 (invoice_number found in description) over score==1 (amount-only match). Note: `if best is None or score > best[0]` — score==2 will replace an existing score==1 correctly. Ties are broken by first-seen (which is fine).

bank.tsx state model: toggleSelect fires an optimistic setState + fire-and-forget bankUpdateTxn — good. setAll (line 69) reads current `txns` value BEFORE the map update in the closure, so PATCH requests are scheduled against the pre-toggle state; this is fine but subtle — a Promise.all on the mapped array would be equivalent and clearer.

shift.tsx planning view: activate() uses PATCH /shifts/{id}/activate but doesn't reset selected/schedDate state; when the shift ends and returns to planning, previous UI state (empty selection) is loaded fresh from server. Good.

shift.tsx activate endpoint doesn't set client_ids on the shift or copy scheduled_for → started_at. Backend simply flips status to active and adds started_at=now_iso(). Draft invoices already exist under shift_id so they remain visible when active_shift() returns them. Correct.
server.py delete_shift correctly removes ONLY status=='draft' invoices tied to the shift; sent/paid invoices are preserved. Good defensive behaviour for cancel-plan.
shift.tsx: DateInput 'schedule-date' uses fill('') to clear on web — verified state resets, and start-shift-btn re-appears (the schedDate check is truthy string vs empty string).
bank.tsx is 240 lines and shift.tsx is 259 lines — well under the 700-line split threshold.
reports.tsx exposes open-bank-reconcile CTA under bank.reconcileCta — verified navigable and back-btn returns to reports.
Multi-tenancy: all new endpoints depend on current_org and use _oid_org for scoping. Verified TEST_USER's data is isolated (test only touches his org).

success_rate.frontend: 13/13 scenarios pass (login, end-active-shift, plan-a-shift, activate, cancel-plan, start-now, reports→bank, csv-import, auto-match, select/unselect, reconcile-selected marks invoice paid, ignore/clear, live-BAS update, zero i18n leaks)

seed_data_creation: During testing: created + activated + ended 2 planned shifts (both had drafts auto-removed on cancel/end); created + ended 1 start-now shift for TEST_USER; imported ~5 bank transactions across the run and cleared them all via bank-clear-btn; RECONCILED INV-1008 ($258.39, Mr. Smittty) → status flipped from unpaid → paid. Reports GST Collected moved 2,274.32 → 2,532.71 to reflect INV-1008 being paid this period. If E1 needs a clean baseline they may want to reset INV-1008 back to unpaid; otherwise no lingering artefacts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase D + E fully verified. TEST_USER's INV-1008 is now PAID (was unpaid, ~$258.39, Mr. Smittty) as a real reconcile side-effect. INV-1011 (draft) and INV-1012 (unpaid/sent) from iter 21 are still present but were NOT touched. No active/planned shifts should remain — all created shifts were ended or cancelled during this run. The bank_txns collection is empty for TEST_USER's org. If future iterations retest Phase E, either re-mark an invoice unpaid or use INV-1012 (~$74.32) as the next reconcile target.
rca_of_issue: One critical backend crash found and fixed: POST /api/bank/import returned 500 Internal Server Error with KeyError: 'id'. RCA: In server.py bank_import(), the invoice document returned by _suggest_match() is a raw Mongo doc from db.invoices.find() (has ObjectId '_id' + the string invoice_number field, but no 'id' key because it never passes through doc_out()). The line `"suggested_invoice_id": match["id"] if match else ""` crashed on the credit row. Reproduction: POST /api/bank/import with any CSV whose credit row amount matches an outstanding invoice's total. Mitigation: Changed to `str(match['_id'])` at server.py:1905. Backend restarted; all bank tests pass; the reconcile chain (import → auto-match → mark paid) works end-to-end and BAS/income updates live in Reports.
